author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam goes hands-on with Hasbro's new Ultimate Grogu animatronic, which is making its public debut this week at San Diego Comic-Con! The product designer and engineers behind this robot walk Adam through Grogu's functions and explain how his movements and expressive animations work under the hood. Plus, what happens when two of these Grogus get close to one another!

Star Wars Ultimate Grogu Life-Size Animatronic: https://www.hasbropulse.com/product/star-wars-ultimate-grogu/G44835S00

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
Additional media courtesy Hasbro
